comparison.objective: Place three consumer devices on matching charging interfaces; candidate sorts cartons by physical open/closed state on a moving line.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1939 tests device-specific magnetic/contact alignment, including handling a flexible watch strap. Candidate tests moving-target sidewall capture beneath articulated flaps and stable transport of free contents.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1939 awards per-device credit for uninterrupted released charging with visible indicators and an unmoved stand. Candidate requires physical rejection or untouched passage according to carton state, with permanent spill penalties.
comparison.reason: Matching charging alignment does not exercise conveyor interception, articulated-obstacle avoidance or payload retention.
